text.text_excerpt: I have been here 3 or 4 times now, and I love this place! The people are genuinely friendly and ready to answer questions or chat about the products. There is a lot of variety throughout the frozen cases- beef, chicken, pork, sides like dressing or pastas or vegetables. Meat pies, sausages. The meats can be plain, such as a seasoned chicken breast, or stuffed such as a rice dressing stuffed pork chop. There are also non-frozen meats, seasoned and vacuumed sealed. Also, there are some fruits, vegetables, sauces, and hot boudin. There is a lot to look through! I have bought several packages of meat pies- they are delicious. Several links of boudin as well. Chris' Specialty Meats is EXACTLY what Lakeview needed. For several years now, 6 to be exact, I have been disappointed with the local availability of quality steaks and meats in Lakeview. And the thought of quality sausages or game such as rabbit, quail or duck were simply out of the question. Then along came Chris' Specialty Meats. Before the building was even complete, I knew this place was going to be a success after having viewed their incredible website. (Do yourself a favor and check it out) This is no fly by night company as they have been in business for a little over 20 years and have locations in Baton Rouge and Prairieville, LA. This is a pretty unique shop. A coworker told me to check it out since I'm basically a carnivore. I was not disappointed. They have your staple meats like pork chops, chicken breasts, legs, wings, thighs, and steaks. They also have meats that are a little more difficult to find in Metairie like turducken sausage, deer sausage, duck, quail, and bison. I bought turducken, a stuffed pork tenderloin, and duck breasts. The pork and duck were seasoned and wrapped in bacon before being vacuum sealed and frozen. All three meats were very good!
